commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unset} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-unset}"; mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1727/${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}; gh pr diff 1727 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1727/${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}/diff.patch | head -5; echo "===FILES==="; gh pr diff 1727 | grep '^diff --git' | sed -E 's#^diff --git a/(.*) b/.*#\1#'

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp; printf '' > .prflow/tmp/displaced-paths.txt; rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null; git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
